compatibility_macros: CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO ST_SetSRID(g, srid) AS g

CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO moses_text(g) AS CASE WHEN typeof(g) IN ('DOUBLE','FLOAT','REAL') OR starts_with(typeof(g),'DECIMAL') THEN regexp_replace(regexp_replace(CAST(g AS VARCHAR), '(\.[0-9]*?)0+$', '\1'), '\.$', '') ELSE CAST(g AS VARCHAR) END
CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO moses_subdivide(g, maxvertices) AS ST_Collect(list_transform(ST_Dump(g), part -> ST_Subdivide(part.geom, maxvertices)))
CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO moses_transform_crs(g, source_srid, target_srid) AS ST_Transform(g, 'EPSG:' || CAST(source_srid AS VARCHAR), 'EPSG:' || CAST(target_srid AS VARCHAR), always_xy := true)

CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO moses_geometrytype(g) AS CASE CAST(ST_GeometryType(g) AS VARCHAR) WHEN 'POLYGON' THEN 'ST_Polygon' WHEN 'MULTIPOLYGON' THEN 'ST_MultiPolygon' WHEN 'POINT' THEN 'ST_Point' WHEN 'MULTIPOINT' THEN 'ST_MultiPoint' WHEN 'LINESTRING' THEN 'ST_LineString' WHEN 'MULTILINESTRING' THEN 'ST_MultiLineString' WHEN 'GEOMETRYCOLLECTION' THEN 'ST_GeometryCollection' END

CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO moses_makevalid(g) AS CASE WHEN CAST(ST_GeometryType(g) AS VARCHAR) IN ('MULTIPOINT','MULTILINESTRING','MULTIPOLYGON','GEOMETRYCOLLECTION') THEN ST_Multi(ST_MakeValid(g)) ELSE ST_MakeValid(g) END
CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO moses_census_tract_numeric_text(g) AS CASE WHEN contains(g, '.') THEN CAST(CAST(g AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS VARCHAR) ELSE CAST(CAST(g AS DECIMAL(38,0)) AS VARCHAR) END
CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO moses_union_agg(g) AS CASE WHEN COUNT(g)=0 THEN NULL::GEOMETRY ELSE ST_Union_Agg(g) END
update_match_policy: Equality-key updates deduplicate the source once per eligible key, then LEFT JOIN; other predicates use LATERAL LIMIT 1. Both preserve target cardinality and matched NULL writes. Unless scoped by canonical_match_policy, multiple-match source choice is arbitrary, as upstream PostgreSQL UPDATE FROM permits.

qaqc.history_policy: Current release QA computed; historical accumulator rows are not copied.

copy_null_policy: Named input__ models convert empty VARCHAR values to NULL where pinned CSV import/seed loading requires it; nonempty text and whitespace are preserved. Already-restored PostgreSQL dumps may retain meaningful empty strings and should not be included.

numeric_policy.rounding: Values beyond scale12 round on cast; NUMERIC multiplication results reset to scale12 after each operation, and decimal ratios recast before ROUND. Products must still fit DuckDB 38-digit intermediates (14 integer digits for two scale12 factors). PostgreSQL arbitrary precision is not claimed.
numeric_policy.numeric_to_text: Strip fixed-scale trailing zeros for numeric values; existing text stays unchanged.
numeric_policy.varchar_casts: Explicit VARCHAR(n) casts truncate to n characters as PostgreSQL does.
numeric_policy.census_tract_text: The pinned ct2010 cleanup produces integer or two-digit fractional text. Its numeric-to-text assignment preserves that scale (170.10), while other numeric text continues to trim adaptation-introduced zeros.

seed_policy: Pinned dbt load_agate_table inference with configured text overrides. Text blank/literal null markers follow Agate; nonnull text codes retain spelling. Numbers remove validated grouping commas and cast strictly to DECIMAL(38,12). All pinned numeric source spellings are checked against Agate during compilation.
spatial_update_policy: The pinned spatialjoins.sql uses unchanged PLUTO serial ids. Materialize matched-only id/value patch tables, then join each patch to the original full rows. This bounds geometry retained by lateral matching without copying full parcel tables; numbered transformation model IDs are preserved.
makevalid_policy: Preserve collection inputs as MULTI when GEOS repairs to a singleton, matching PostGIS lwgeom_make_valid_params. Original atomic inputs and mixed-dimensional collections retain native repair behavior.
union_aggregate_policy: Single-argument PostgreSQL ST_Union returns SQL NULL for empty/all-NULL groups. Guard DuckDB ST_Union_Agg with COUNT(g)=0; preserve explicit nonnull empty geometries and mixed NULL/valid input. Binary ST_Union remains native.

canonical_match_policy.scope: Equality-key CAMA update family and ZIP spatial fallback only.
canonical_match_policy.ordering: Existing identity columns first (CAMA bbl,bldgnum,primebbl,billingbbl; ZIP zipcode,ogc_fid), then every remaining source column alphabetically. Canonical VARCHAR values ascend with NULLS LAST; geometry uses hexadecimal WKB. Equal full payload rows make identical assignments.
canonical_match_policy.interpretation: Operational replay policy, not upstream business precedence or a choice derived from reference outputs.
canonical_match_policy.replay_limitation: Other multiple-match UPDATE sources and existing upstream window ties retain their pinned unordered choice; complete replay invariance is not claimed.

qa_factoring_verification.method: Original versus rendered shared-macro token streams, ignoring whitespace/comments and a whole-query wrapper.

consolidation.policy: Explicit business boundaries, shared source macros, local rule CTEs; fuse only adjacent pure disjoint projection updates with independent read sets.

project_kind: Maintained review snapshot; regenerate with write_review_project after compiler changes.
